body.prose: One question, are you saying that expressions can be used in fields? I didn't know that. And we are talking about making the [dimension] not the first class thing, but something that rests upon the substrate. But I think you just did a take here without reasoning properly. I mean, what does that actually mean? Because then a brief can't be dimension. Then the brief needs its dimension as well. So then you need to do double duty. So I don't know. Did you really reason enough?
body.title: Did you reason enough
